description: This file implements a proxy application for managing audio and participant events in a video conferencing context, utilizing asyncio for asynchronous operations, handling participant join/leave events, and managing audio streams.

classes.name: DailyProxyApp
classes.description: A class that manages a video conferencing session, handling participant events, audio streams, and subscriptions using asyncio and custom event handling.

methods.name: completion_callback
methods.description: Creates a callback to set the result of a future based on asyncio task completion.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the DailyProxyApp with a given sample rate, setting up client and audio sources.

methods.name: on_joined
methods.description: Handles the event when the local participant joins the meeting.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Starts the asyncio event loop, sets up signal handlers, and joins the meeting.

methods.name: leave
methods.description: Leaves the meeting and cancels ongoing audio tasks.

methods.name: update_subscriptions
methods.description: Updates participant and profile subscriptions asynchronously.

methods.name: _create_audio_task
methods.description: Creates an asyncio task for handling audio data.

methods.name: _cancel_audio_task
methods.description: Cancels the ongoing audio task gracefully.

methods.name: capture_participant_audio
methods.description: Subscribes to a participant's audio stream for capturing.

methods.name: send_audio
methods.description: Sends audio data through the custom audio source.

methods.name: _audio_data_received
methods.description: Callback for when audio data is received, queues it for sending.

methods.name: _audio_task_handler
methods.description: Continuously processes queued audio data and sends it.

methods.name: on_participant_joined
methods.description: Handles participant join events, subscribing to Pipecat's audio.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initializes the application and starts the event loop.
